主要内容: Selim Syed, Managing Director at Mizuho, discussed the future of biotech companies amid a sector drop. He highlighted that more than 20% of the NASDAQ Biotech Index's members are trading for less than cash, indicating a significant decline in the sector. Syed provided insights into the challenges facing biotech firms, including market volatility and investor sentiment. The discussion took place on May 9, 2022, during the Worldwide Exchange. The event focused on the broader implications of the sector drop and potential strategies for biotech companies to navigate the current market conditions.
